rationale: The packet directories below hold author, referee and integration code copied verbatim into computations/verification/line*/ and pinned by sha256 in the packets' SHA manifests or in dated evidence receipts. They are frozen evidence of what was run, not maintained entry points. Adding the assertion guard, or rewriting an invalid escape sequence, would change their bytes and break those manifests. They are therefore outside the assertion-entry policy (computations/maintenance/assertion_policy.py) and outside the compileall SyntaxWarning-as-error step. The exemption is per file and fail-closed: a file is exempt only while it lies under a listed directory, is listed below, and its current sha256 equals the listed value, which must also appear verbatim in the listed pin file. An edited file loses its exemption and falls back under the policy. Unpinned files in the same directories are not exempt and carry the guard. All non-packet code stays covered.
